T1.evaluation_status: DEFERRED — requires full-video inference, not feasible with 3 anchor frames
T1.rationale: T1 cannot be rigorously evaluated on 3 anchor frames per dive. Viterbi spatial path was shown to regress with D4-era FPs. T0 achieves 100% DEV_TRAIN and 83.3% DEV_VAL, already a major improvement. T1 risk: propagating apex/water-contact FP errors across full trajectory.

frozen_selector_description: Per-frame top-1 R1 (ResNet50 visual reranker) score
d5_rationale: Paris apex: D4_rank=10 → R1_rank=2. The apex target is visually distinct but not sufficiently so from spectators with the current DEVELOPMENT training distribution. D5 aims to add more apex/water-contact frames to improve R1 generalization and push the diver to rank 1 at Paris apex.
